_comment: Per-asset leverage tiers. The risk engine looks up the symbol's tier and uses (default | high_conviction_70 | high_conviction_80) based on confluence score. Falls back to risk_params.json leverage_limits if a symbol isn't listed. The `enabled` flag gates whole asset classes — flip to true once the broker adapter is wired and paper-tested. Tiers are deliberately aggressive: a 250 EUR budget needs leverage to generate meaningful P&L, and the 2%-per-trade risk cap means leverage only affects margin (not loss), provided exchange-side SL fills (slippage on flash crashes is the real residual risk).

crypto_perp._note: Post-MiCA (2026-05): OKX blocks EU residents on all crypto perps. We route crypto via Alpaca spot for BTC/ETH/SOL (no leverage, long-only) and synthetic for everything else (paper R&D). Tiers below reflect that — 1x for the Alpaca-routed pairs; legacy tiers preserved for the synthetic-routed alts in case we ever want to re-enable a perp venue.

stock_equity._note: ESMA caps retail stock CFD leverage at 5x. Enable once stock broker adapter is wired.

forex_spot._note: ESMA caps retail forex majors at 30x. Enable once FX broker adapter is wired.
